summary: Flat, parked-up west kerb at the top of Beatrice Street, with homes 10-19 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Units 12 m and houses 10-19 m away on the west side, plus houses across the road; overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars already parked on this kerb; room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, some local through traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; several cars park here, though no overnight-van convention.

flags: Steep beyond 40 m (up to 20%), so only the flat top is usable
sun_shade: Mostly open; some shade from trees on the east side in the afternoon.

best_section.where: West kerb of Beatrice Street, just south of the first junction, opposite the new houses
